blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A routine afternoon errand turned fatal for a 16-year-old boy who died after suffering an apparent electrocution while washing his motorcycle at a coin-operated car wash station in Barangay Butong, Pinamungajan, on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026. According to initial findings from the Pinamungajan Municipal Police Station, the tragedy unfolded at around 12:30 p.m. in Purok African Daisy, Barangay Butong, at a self-service car wash facility owned by Jeffrey Villarin.
